Can also be purchased from strike, raid, or fractal vendors. | id = 19675 }} [[Mystic Clover]] is a [[crafting material]] used in the creation of [[legendary equipment]]. == Acquisition == === Overview === Mystic Clovers can be acquired through multiple methods: * [[Mystic Forge]] — Forged directly using {{item icon|Mystic Coin}}s, {{item icon|Glob of Ectoplasm|Globs of Ectoplasm}}, {{item icon|Obsidian Shard}}s, and {{item icon|Spirit Shard}}s (for {{item icon|Philosopher's Stone}} or {{item icon|Mystic Crystal}}). ** Also available for {{currency|3|Mystic Coin}} + {{currency|5|Glob of Ectoplasm}} + {{currency|3|Obsidian Shard}} + {{spirit shard|3}} from [[Miyani]]/[[Mystic Forge Attendant]]s (combined weekly limit of 10), and [[Lyhr]]/[[Ward Crafter Lucirae]] (unlimited). * [[Reward track]]s — Earned from [[PvP Reward Track]]s, [[WvW Reward Track]]s, and [[Skirmish reward track]] (through {{item icon|Mist-Warped Bundle}}). * Vendors — Purchased weekly for {{item icon|Mystic Coin|2 Mystic Coins}}, {{item icon|Glob of Ectoplasm|2 Globs of Ectoplasm}}, and {{item icon|Spirit Shard|2 Spirit Shards}} per {{item icon|Mystic Clover|Mystic Clover}}, plus an additional currency depending on the vendor: ** [[Fractals of the Mists]]: {{token|fr|150}} from [[BUY-4373]] (limit 10 per week). ** [[Raids]]: {{token|ms|30}} from [[Manfred Njallson]] (limit 15 per week). ** [[PvP]]: {{item icon|Emblem of Tournament Victory}} or {{token|pvp lt|5}} from [[League Vendor]] (combined limit 5 per week). ** [[WvW]]: {{token|wvw|10}} + {{token|wvw sct|20}} from [[Dugan]] (limit 5 per week; does not require {{item icon|Spirit Shard}}). ** [[Lunar New Year]]: {{item icon|Exotic Essence of Luck|10 Exotic Essence of Luck}} from [[New Year Rewards]] (limit 1 per week; does not require other items). * [[Wizard's Vault]] — Purchased for {{token|Astral Acclaim|60}} each (limit 20 per season). * [[Unbound Magic]] — Very low chance from {{item icon|Magic-Warped Bundle}}. * [[Achievement]]s ** [[Glory to the Legions]] — Similar to repeatable Reward Tracks, the final chest of each achievement (reward tier 20) contains {{item icon |Mystic Clover|2 Mystic Clovers}}. ** [[Chest of Legendary Crafting Materials]] rewarded from five "Strike Back" achievements, containing a total of {{item icon|Mystic Clover|35 Mystic Clovers}} (non-repeatable). === Recipes === {{recipe | name = 1 Mystic Clover or other materials (random) | link = Mystic Clover | source = Mystic Forge | quantity = 1 | ingredient1 = 1 Obsidian Shard | ingredient2 = 1 Mystic Coin | ingredient3 = 1 Glob of Ectoplasm | ingredient4 = 6 Philosopher's Stone | base ingredients calculation = n }} {{recipe | name = 10 Mystic Clovers or other materials (random) | link = Mystic Clover | source = Mystic Forge | quantity = 10 | ingredient1 = 10 Obsidian Shard | ingredient2 = 10 Mystic Coin | ingredient3 = 10 Glob of Ectoplasm | ingredient4 = 10 Mystic Crystal | base ingredients calculation = n }}

The recipes only have a ''chance'' to produce [[Mystic Clover]]s, estimated through drop research to be about 31%.https://old.reddit.com/r/Guildwars2/comments/14v6gj9/data_we_forged_40k_mystic_clovers_to_settle_the/ The rest of the time, a weightedhttps://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1vJQkQEXjtKme-SUUdoHFqu6YiG1kadAig9ttJ-xXP6s/edit random item of the following is given instead (quantities listed are for the 1 clover recipe; the 10 clover recipe will yield ten times as many): * 1-3 of a tier 6 refined [[basic crafting material]]: ** {{item icon|Ancient Wood Plank}}, {{item icon|Bolt of Gossamer}}, {{item icon|Cured Hardened Leather Square}}, or {{item icon|Orichalcum Ingot}} * 2-4 of a tier 6 [[fine crafting material]]: ** {{item icon|Ancient Bone}}, {{item icon|Armored Scale}}, {{item icon|Elaborate Totem}}, {{item icon|Pile of Crystalline Dust}}, {{item icon|Powerful Venom Sac}}, {{item icon|Vial of Powerful Blood}}, {{item icon|Vicious Claw}}, or {{item icon|Vicious Fang}} * 1 of a select tier 5 [[rare crafting material]]: ** {{item icon|Corrupted Lodestone}}, {{item icon|Crystal Lodestone}}, {{item icon|Destroyer Lodestone}}, or {{item icon|Pile of Putrid Essence}} * 2 {{item icon|Glob of Ectoplasm|Globs of Ectoplasm}} * 5 {{item icon|Mystic Coin}}s * 2 {{item icon|Crystal}}s * 2 {{item icon|Obsidian Shard}}s * 1 {{item icon|Hidden Treasure}} See [[Mystic Clover#Notes]] for more information about averages and probabilities. === Sold by === Note that vendors with identical costs share the weekly limit. An exception is [[Lyhr]] and [[Ward Crafter Lucirae]], who do not have a weekly limit, and buying from them will not count against the weekly limits of [[Miyani]] and the [[Mystic Forge Attendant]]s even though their costs are the same. Clover/Drop rate|here]]. * Assuming that both recipes have the same chance to produce clover, the average cost to obtain a single clover: ** {{#expr:1/.31 round1}} [[Mystic Coin]]s ** {{#expr:1/.31 round1}} [[Obsidian Shard]]s ** {{#expr:1/.31 round1}} [[Glob of Ectoplasm|Globs of Ectoplasm]] ** {{#expr:(6*(1/10))/.31 round2}} [[spirit shard]]s * The above calculation does not take into account any drops of these items you might receive from 'failed' attempts. * A [[Gift of Fortune]] or [[Mystic Tribute]] will require {{currency|154|Mystic Coin}} + {{currency|154|Glob of Ectoplasm}} + {{currency|154|Spirit Shard}} if the 77 Mystic Clovers are exclusively purchased from weekly vendors. ** Additionally depending on the vendor, it will cost {{token|fr|11550}}, {{currency|2310|Magnetite Shard}}, or {{currency|2310|Blue Prophet Shard}}. === Probability notes === Both [[Mystic Forge]] recipes have technically identical costs. [[/Drop rate|Drop rate research]] suggests that both recipes have around 30-32% of yielding clovers, and drop the same materials. Keep in mind though that the 1-clover recipe is more likely to produce average odds on the way to crafting any particular piece of legendary gear. (See the [[Talk:Mystic Clover|talk page]] for details and discussion.) This does not mean the 1-clover recipe will give you more clovers, just that you are more likely to end up with an amount close to what would statistically be expected due to lower [[w:Variance|variance]]. Roughly speaking, the 10x recipe is faster and less tedious, while the 1x recipe is more reliable, when working on 70-80 clovers. Remember though that when using the 10x recipe, it is always statistically cheaper to produce amounts below 10 (e.g. from 70 to 77 clovers) with the 1x recipe. == See also == * [[Crafting material#Advanced crafting materials|Advanced crafting materials]] [[de:Mystischer Glücksklee]] [[es:Trébol místico]] [[fr:Trèfle mystique]] [[Category:Wizard's Vault]]
